footer.desc: Leading diagnostic laboratory in Tashkent. Specialized in pathomorphology, clinical testing, molecular genetics, and mobile sample collection.
footer.helpDesc: Submit a request, and our specialists will help you select the appropriate diagnostic tests.

hero.title: A laboratory where precision empowers clinical decisions
hero.desc: IPSUM Pathology combines pathomorphology, comprehensive clinical diagnostics, and modern patient-centric service to ensure the pathway from appointment to results is seamless, fast, and dependable.

pathomorphology.title: Pathomorphology Laboratory
pathomorphology.text: Full spectrum of morphological diagnostics: histology, cytology, intraoperative frozen section diagnostics, immunohistochemistry, molecular diagnostics, and digital pathology.

clinical.title: Clinical Diagnostic Laboratory
clinical.text: Comprehensive modern laboratory testing: routine clinical, biochemistry, hematology, coagulation, immunology, microbiology, hormone assays, molecular genetics, and tumor markers.

ngs.title: NGS (Next-Generation Sequencing)
ngs.text: Complete high-throughput sequencing workflow: targeted and whole-genome panels, exome/transcriptome sequencing, liquid biopsy, bioinformatic analysis, and clinical interpretation.

pcr.title: RT-PCR (Real-Time PCR)
pcr.text: Full cycle of real-time PCR diagnostics: quantitative and qualitative detection of mutations and translocations, gene expression analysis, minimal residual disease monitoring, and infectious disease diagnostics.

cytogenetics.title: Cytogenetics & FISH
cytogenetics.text: Full cycle of cytogenetic diagnostics: classic karyotyping, FISH on native and paraffin-embedded tissue specimens, detection of chromosomal aberrations, and oncologic diagnostics.

cytometry.title: Flow Cytometry
cytometry.text: Full cycle of flow cytometry: immunophenotyping of hematological malignancies, minimal residual disease evaluation, cell cycle analysis, leukemia and lymphoma diagnostics, and multi-color panel testing.

trust.title: Precision, speed, and uncompromising quality
trust.text: IPSUM Pathology unifies laboratory medicine, pathomorphology, and molecular diagnostics under rigorous quality standards, delivering clear and actionable answers for physicians and patients.
trust.f1_text: Clinical, pathological, and molecular testing consolidated into a single unified system.
trust.f2_text: Advanced automated analyzers engineered for consistent, accurate, and reproducible results.
trust.f3_text: Meticulous verification across every phase: from sample accessioning to final expert sign-off.
trust.f4_text: Effortless scheduling, personalized administrator guidance, and instant online access to test reports.

process.title: Diagnostic testing made effortless
process.subtitle: From initial inquiry to final diagnostic report — a clear and hassle-free pathway.
process.s1_text: Select your tests or leave your contact details; our specialist will promptly confirm specifics and scheduling.
process.s2_text: Visit one of our diagnostic centers or request our mobile team for on-site sample collection at your location.
process.s3_text: Access your verified diagnostic reports securely online, via Telegram bot, or collect printed copies at our branch.

partners.title: International expertise for accurate diagnostics
partners.desc: IPSUM Pathology collaborates with world-renowned medical institutions, biotechnology innovators, and laboratory leaders. This partnership fosters adoption of cutting-edge diagnostic methodologies and global quality standards.

cleveland.name: Cleveland Clinic
cleveland.text: One of the world's leading medical institutions. Our partnership facilitates direct access to advanced diagnostic protocols and international clinical best practices.

roche.name: Hoffmann-La Roche
roche.text: Global pioneer in pharmaceuticals and diagnostics. Joint collaboration advances immunohistochemistry workflows and standardized quality control.

centogene.name: CENTOGENE
centogene.text: Global leader in genetic diagnostics for rare diseases. Partnership expands our capabilities in specialized molecular genetic testing and rare pathologies.

core.name: Core Diagnostics
core.text: Next-generation clinical laboratory. Collaborative exchange drives modern diagnostic innovation and regional best practices.

foundation.name: Foundation Medicine
foundation.text: Pioneer in molecular oncology diagnostics. Collaboration enables comprehensive genomic profiling for personalized precision cancer therapies.

onecell.name: OneCell Diagnostics
onecell.text: Biotech innovator in single-cell genomics and liquid biopsy, advancing early detection and molecular monitoring of oncology conditions.

memorial.name: Memorial Health Group
memorial.text: Leading network of international medical centers in Turkey, facilitating joint clinical expertise in oncology diagnostics and patient care.

gallery.title: High-tech environment for precise laboratory diagnostics
gallery.desc: Modern diagnostic accuracy demands stringent specimen handling, calibrated automation, and attentive patient care.

about.title: IPSUM PATHOLOGY
about.text: We combine laboratory precision, cutting-edge technology, and attentive patient communication.

mission.title: Precision that empowers informed medical decisions
mission.text: IPSUM Pathology is dedicated to patients and clinicians who require reliable laboratory data, seamless service, and rapid report availability. We make the diagnostic pathway transparent and accessible.
mission.h3: Multi-tier quality control across all stages

corporate.s1_title: A transparent and reassuring pathway from the very first contact
corporate.s1_text: We focus on patient comfort: our administrative team assists with test selection, pre-analytical preparation instructions, and digital report retrieval.
corporate.s2_title: High-tech infrastructure engineered for dependable diagnostics
corporate.s2_text: Testing is performed in a controlled laboratory environment equipped with modern robotic instrumentation adhering to international biosafety standards.

values.title: The pillars of our clinical trust
values.v1_text: Rigorous standardization, reproducibility, and attention to detail at every analytical milestone.
values.v2_text: Convenient scheduling, respectful specimen collection, and clear communication throughout the process.
values.v3_text: Adopting the latest global advancements in clinical chemistry, molecular biology, and digital pathology.

route.title: From sample intake to results without unnecessary complexity
route.desc: Our diagnostic workflow is structured to minimize uncertainty, ensure rapid turnaround times, and provide reliable clinical reports.
route.step1_text: Our administrative team guides you through test selection, preparation guidelines, and optimal appointment timing.
route.step2_text: Biological samples undergo automated processing and analysis within strictly controlled cleanroom environments.
route.step3_text: Expert-verified findings are delivered digitally or in print to enable timely therapeutic decision-making.

licenses.title: Licenses and Certifications
licenses.desc: IPSUM Pathology is fully licensed by the Ministry of Health of the Republic of Uzbekistan and regularly participates in external quality assessment programs.
licenses.l1_desc: Official medical activity license issued by the Ministry of Health of Uzbekistan
licenses.l3_desc: Certificate of compliance with ISO international quality management standards

intro.title: Training expert specialists in advanced laboratory diagnostics
intro.desc: The program is designed for medical graduates seeking mastery of modern diagnostic techniques, complex histological analysis, and advanced pathomorphology practice.

features.f1: Hands-on practical training led by leading clinical pathomorphologists
features.f2: In-depth study of immunohistochemistry, molecular genetics, and digital pathology
features.f3: Interdisciplinary clinical case discussions and tumor board participation

gallery.title: State-of-the-art clinical and laboratory training facility
gallery.desc: Residents engage in real clinical diagnostic workflows, operating next-generation histological, IHC, and molecular diagnostic instrumentation.
gallery.g3: Automated digital microscopy and slide scanning

international.title: International Academic Collaboration
international.desc: Our institution actively collaborates with leading medical centers and research institutes in the USA, Turkey, and India, offering residents access to international clinical knowledge and best practices.

diploma.title: Certification & Career Opportunities
diploma.desc: Graduates receive a state-recognized diploma upon completion of the clinical residency, opening career pathways in leading national diagnostic centers and international pathology laboratories.
